name: paneru
title: Paneru
description: Control Paneru, the scrollable tiling window manager for macOS. Run any Paneru command, from focusing and swapping windows to resizing, stacking, and virtual workspaces, via paneru send-cmd.
author: joshwilsonvu

commands.name: paneru
commands.title: Paneru Commands
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Browse and run every Paneru window management command.

commands.name: window-focus-west
commands.title: Focus Window Left
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Focus the window to the left.

commands.name: window-focus-east
commands.title: Focus Window Right
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Focus the window to the right.

commands.name: window-focus-north
commands.title: Focus Window Up
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Focus the window up in the stack, or the display in that direction.

commands.name: window-focus-south
commands.title: Focus Window Down
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Focus the window down in the stack, or the display in that direction.

commands.name: window-focus-first
commands.title: Focus Window First
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Jump to the first window in the strip.

commands.name: window-focus-last
commands.title: Focus Window Last
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Jump to the last window in the strip.

commands.name: window-focus-number
commands.title: Focus Window by Column Number

commands.name: window-focus-managed
commands.title: Focus Last Tiled Window
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Focus the previously focused managed (tiled) window on this workspace.

commands.name: window-focus-unmanaged
commands.title: Focus Last Floating Window
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Focus the previously focused floating window on this workspace.

commands.name: window-swap-west
commands.title: Swap Window Left
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Swap the focused window with its left neighbour.

commands.name: window-swap-east
commands.title: Swap Window Right
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Swap the focused window with its right neighbour.

commands.name: window-swap-north
commands.title: Swap Window Up
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Swap the window up in the stack, or move it to the display in that direction.

commands.name: window-swap-south
commands.title: Swap Window Down
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Swap the window down in the stack, or move it to the display in that direction.

commands.name: window-swap-first
commands.title: Swap Window First
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Move the focused window to the start of the strip.

commands.name: window-swap-last
commands.title: Swap Window Last
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Move the focused window to the end of the strip.

commands.name: window-center
commands.title: Center Window
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Center the focused window in the viewport.

commands.name: window-grow
commands.title: Grow Window Width
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Cycle the focused window to the next preset column width.

commands.name: window-shrink
commands.title: Shrink Window Width
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Cycle the focused window to the previous preset column width.

commands.name: window-vertical-grow
commands.title: Grow Window Height
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Cycle a stacked window to the next preset height.

commands.name: window-vertical-shrink
commands.title: Shrink Window Height
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Cycle a stacked window to the previous preset height.

commands.name: window-fullwidth
commands.title: Toggle Full Width
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Toggle full-width mode for the focused window.

commands.name: window-balance
commands.title: Balance Columns
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Make all columns in the strip match the focused window's width.

commands.name: window-snap
commands.title: Snap Window into View
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Resize and reposition an overflowing window to fit the visible viewport.

commands.name: window-stack
commands.title: Stack Window
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Stack the focused window onto the column to its left.

commands.name: window-unstack
commands.title: Unstack Window
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Pull the focused window out of its stack into its own column.

commands.name: window-equalize
commands.title: Equalize Stack Heights
commands.subtitle: Paneru
commands.description: Give all windows in the focused stack equal height.

commands.name: window-tabbeddisplay

commands.name: window-nextdisplay

commands.name: window-nextdisplaysend

commands.name: mouse-nextdisplay
